quotes.text: // Copy properties that the server doesn't know about.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When a server response replaces a CardDAV card, copy local non-vCard properties from the existing card. Exclude _vCard, _etag, _href, LastModifiedDate, and banished properties. Otherwise a local PopularityIndex update is lost when the card is fetched again.
title: Preserve local CardDAV properties after server refresh
